title: The reason page is headed 'Main reason for import' in DR1 and 'What is the main reason for importing the animals?' in the frontend, where the two-line question pushes the first radio down the screen.

finding.frontend: The page's h1 is the question itself — 'What is the main reason for importing the animals?' — set large, and at the captured width it wraps onto two lines before the first radio (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/import-reason/copy/copy.en.js:2-3).
finding.prototype: DR1 heads the page with the short topic 'Main reason for import' and keeps the question as the radio group's legend, hidden from sight but read out to screen readers. Sighted users get a short heading and the five options; screen-reader users still hear the full question when they enter the group (app/views/reason-for-import.html:42, :50-55).
finding.difference: Change the h1 to 'Main reason for import' and move 'What is the main reason for importing the animals?' into the fieldset legend as visually hidden text, so nothing is lost for screen readers. The hub already names the task 'Main reason for importing', so this also stops the heading and the task row telling the user two different things.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding that DR1's reason page renders the full question as its visible h1 for a DR1 session, with the short heading applied only under a design-release-2 branch.
finding.correction: Verified sound, including the wrap. evidence/frontend@76a864ba/page/fe-import-reason.png shows 'What is the main reason for importing the animals?' breaking after 'for' and running to two lines above the first radio; evidence/prototype@491b3926/page/dr1-reason-for-import-temporary-admission-horses-revealed.png shows DR1's single-line 'Main reason for import' under the caption 'About the consignment'. The DR1 citations are exact — the h1 is at app/views/reason-for-import.html:42 and the visually-hidden legend carrying the full question at :50-55, with no design-release branch around either, so the falsifier does not fire. MIS-CITED, slot left as it stands: the frontend slot cites copy.en.js:2-3 for the claim that the question is the h1. That file holds the strings but says nothing about heading level; what makes the question the h1 is isPageHeading: true with govuk-fieldset__legend--l on the radios macro at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/import-reason/template.njk:11-19, and that is where the work lands. Note also that copy.en.js:2 sets title: 'Reason for import', which is the page title and the breadcrumb text, not the h1 — the two are already different strings on the frontend, so the fix is to the legend, not to title. HOW CHECKED: read both screenshots; read the frontend copy file and template and the DR1 view.
